traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Cycadaceae and Zamiaceae (with Stangeriaceae, now in Zamiaceae): evergreen; stems thick and little branched (pachycaul), palm-like or a short tuber, carrying the leaves in a crown at the top; leaves pinnate (Zamiaceae very occasionally bipinnate); male and female plants separate, by X and Y chromosomes.
